verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's docs state outright that you can search the web and get full page content from results in one call, which matches the story exactly. The SDK overview also confirms search is a first-class operation alongside scrape. The evidence is a short first-party claim with no detail, so missing for 10: in-depth documentation of search parameters and returned content formats per result, and independent or hands-on corroboration of search-with-content behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search the web and get full page content from results in a single call instead of just links and snippets
